description: Sri Lanka Customs -  Rates of Exchange effective from 09.12.2019 to 15.12.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While it names an individual (C. Jayasuriya, Acting Director General of Customs), this is in an official capacity to establish the legal authority for the notification, not to announce a personnel change. The core content is purely regulatory, establishing legally binding exchange rates.
